faq.sectionSubtitle: Find answers to the most common questions about our guarding and security services.

q1.question: Which areas do you cover?
q1.answer: We mainly operate across the DRC, with mobile teams able to quickly reach surrounding communes and neighborhoods. Contact us to check availability in your area.

q2.question: How does setting up a contract work?
q2.answer: After your quote request, our team assesses your needs, proposes a tailored offer, and sets up the service within 48 to 72 hours depending on the mission's complexity.

q3.question: Are your guards trained and vetted?
q3.answer: Yes. Every guard is carefully selected, trained before taking up their post, and monitored regularly throughout their assignment.

q4.question: What happens in case of an incident?
q4.answer: Our guards are trained to react immediately and alert our control center. A mobile team can be dispatched on site and you are informed in real time.

q5.question: Do you offer services for businesses?
q5.answer: Yes, we protect private homes as well as business premises, with tailored solutions adapted to the size and needs of your organization.

q6.question: How long does it take to receive a quote?
q6.answer: Our team usually gets back to you within 24 hours of your request to refine your needs and send you a personalized proposal.

q7.question: What payment methods do you accept?
q7.answer: We accept cash, bank transfer and Mobile Money payments, with monthly terms or terms based on your contract duration.

q8.question: Can I modify or cancel my contract?
q8.answer: Yes, you can adjust your service level or end the contract by contacting us in advance, according to the terms agreed at signing.

q9.question: Are your guards armed?
q9.answer: Our guards are trained in deterrence and rapid response. The use of armed agents depends on the assessed risk level and current regulations.

q10.question: Can I track my guards' reports online?
q10.answer: Yes, our online owner portal lets you view your contracts, payments and guard reports at any time.
